report.explanation: Operator hypothesis that a recent deployment caused checkout failures is unsupported by current evidence. Traces show a successful checkout (OK, 70ms), logs show request_complete ok/200, and metrics show low error rate (0.0012), zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. The deployment record only proves version facts (3.1.2 to 3.1.3, 2581 min old) and cannot establish causation. No bounded cause is established; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Current error/failure telemetry for checkout (5xx rates, failed spans) to confirm any checkout failure exists
Evidence tying order version 3.1.3 behavior to checkout failures, e.g. error onset aligned with deploy time
Dependency-level traces/metrics (db, redis, downstream) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency
Configuration diff or validation results for 3.1.3 to assess bad-configuration
